justification: The exact package contains 24 production classes in javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/printer/lexicalpreservation, totaling 5,356 LOC. I inspected LexicalPreservingPrinter.java (882 LOC), LexicalDifferenceCalculator.java, Difference.java (1,206 LOC), NodeText.java, TextElementIteratorsFactory.java, and PhantomNodeLogic.java; together they show the package concentrates printer entry points, AST change observation, diff calculation/application, token/text model management, iterator machinery, and phantom-node logic in one place, which is strong structural evidence of a God Component.
